_comment: Distributions extracted once from the operations workbook (September 2026 report preparation) and reviewed: numbers and generic ServiceNow or monitoring vocabulary only.
No customer, staff or ticket text from the workbook is in this file; the generator never reads the workbook. Values marked 'assumed' are not in the workbook and were chosen for the simulation.
Volumes are the workbook's per-customer median, per month, scaled to one customer.

volumes_per_month._source: incidents 747 across 9 customers (median about 65); changes 127 across 10; requests 97 across 12; project tasks 16 across the estate

resolve_hours_lognormal._source: resolve time quantiles per priority: median and 90th percentile, hours

closure_mix._source: the workbook's closure column, mapped to ServiceNow close codes: workaround, permanent, cancelled, auto-close, other

close_note_shape_mix._source: close note shapes by keyword share: healed/recovered alert, copied from parent, returned to normal after monitoring, cancelled or duplicate, structured multi-line

theme_mix._source: alert metric mix from the alerts sheet, restricted to what applies to virtual machines

actual_hours_lognormal._source: assumed: the workbook records no hours on incidents

type_mix._source: Planned 75.6% as normal, Standard 7.9%, Unplanned 11% and Emergency 5.5% as emergency

actual_hours_lognormal._source: assumed: the workbook records no time on requests

price_lognormal._source: made up (ADR 0038): the workbook has no project prices

commercial._source: revenue sheet: median monthly manage revenue about 5,300; manage cost to revenue median 0.689 (10th 0.614, 90th 0.909); revenue to consumption median 0.153
